name: Stormbrow the Elder
summary: Near Goldshire, Stormbrow the Elder greets travelers during the Lunar Festival. They honor Azeroth’s ancient traditions and olden races, and receive a commemorative coin in return.

sections.title: A Spirit in Goldshire
sections.body: Behind Goldshire’s smithy, a quiet pond lies beneath the forest canopy. There Stormbrow the Elder appears as an honored spirit. Guards, tradesfolk, and travelers pass through the town as visitors come to honor the realm’s long history.

sections.title: Honoring the Olden Races
sections.body: During the Lunar Festival, the spirits of great ancestors return to walk among the living. Stormbrow commends travelers who remember those who came before. For honoring the elder peoples’ wisdom and legacy, visitors receive a blessing and a commemorative coin.

faq.q: Where can I find Elder Stormbrow?
faq.answer: Find Stormbrow the Elder beside the pond behind the blacksmith’s forge in Goldshire, in Elwynn Forest.
Stormbrow the Elder is an ancestral spirit who appears during the Lunar Festival. The spirit represents the revered elders of Azeroth’s olden races.

faq.q: What is the purpose of visiting Elder Stormbrow?
faq.answer: Travelers visit Stormbrow the Elder to honor ancient ancestors during the festival. The spirit offers greetings and a token of appreciation in return.

faq.q: Can Horde players speak to Elder Stormbrow?
faq.answer: The Lunar Festival elders honor all who seek them in peace. Goldshire is heavily guarded Alliance territory, so a visit is perilous for Horde travelers.

faq.q: What token does the Elder offer?
faq.answer: Stormbrow the Elder offers a Coin of Ancestry, a traditional token of respect and remembrance shared by elders throughout the festival.

faq.q: Why does Stormbrow mention the 'olden races'?
faq.answer: Stormbrow commends travelers who remember that present civilizations walk lands shaped by ancient peoples and enduring customs. Those peoples and customs came long before the modern kingdoms.

angles.text: As a human living in Elwynn, you can look to Stormbrow the Elder as a reminder of ancient history beyond Stormwind’s walls and its recent wars.
As an Alliance traveler passing through Goldshire, you can find Stormbrow the Elder in the heart of Elwynn Forest, among the most accessible ancestral spirits for young adventurers.
